info.name: CRM Lite
info.description: CRM Lite backend API collection. Import together with CRM-Lite.local.postman_environment.json and read docs/postman/README.md for startup order, execution order and how dynamic variables are populated. AUTHENTICATION (ADR-006..008): every business request through the gateway needs a logged-in BFF session (Authorization Code + PKCE via the browser — see folder 09 and the README §Authentication). Direct Grant/ROPC is disabled by design; never store passwords or tokens in this collection.

item.name: 09 - Authentication (session probe and logout)
item.description: The gateway is a cookie-session BFF (ADR-007): it does NOT accept Authorization: Bearer. Log in once via the BROWSER (http://localhost:8080/api/session/me -> Keycloak login ayilmaz/crm-dev), then copy the JSESSIONID and XSRF-TOKEN cookie values from browser devtools into Postman: Cookies (below the Send button) -> Add domain localhost -> add both cookies for port 8080. Postman then sends them automatically; set the xsrfToken environment variable to the XSRF-TOKEN value for unsafe requests (folders 04/05/06 write operations). Full contract: docs/api/authentication.md.

item.name: 10 - Billing Accounts (FR-ACCT)
item.description: account-service via the gateway (ADR-013/014). Run top-to-bottom: the create stores createdAccountNumber, which the update/delete/passive requests reuse. Login (folder 09 / README) required; write requests carry X-XSRF-TOKEN pre-set. Delete = PASSIVATION: the row stays in the list as Passive (v8-1 AC-ACCT-04-02). The K-8 223 Customer Account (seed 1261000002) is never exposed by the API.

FR-ACCT-02 + KR-11. Account type is NOT client-selectable (forced 224). addressId 1 is seed customer 1001's primary address. If 1001 had no 223 yet, K-8 would lazily create it in the same transaction (seed already has one).
Unknown/immutable properties are rejected, never silently ignored (ADR-013 §3).

item.name: Delete account with active products -> 409 (seed guard)

request.description: AC-ACCT-04-03: seed involvement rows (cust_acct_prod_invl) block passivation of 1261000010.
AC-ACCT-04-02 (v8-1): 204 No Content; the row is NOT removed — it stays list-visible as Passive. The frontend shows MSG-ACCT-DELETED after this response.
Approved policy: not idempotent-204 and not 404 — the record demonstrably still exists.
